responsibility: This file implements Windows-specific support routines for libgccjit. It provides formatted reporting of Win32 last-error messages and a secure win_mkdtemp replacement that finds a temporary base directory, generates randomized libgccjit subdirectories, and creates them with ACLs restricted to the current user. Its responsibility is platform adaptation for error handling and private temp-directory creation on Windows hosts.
same_name_distinction: Implements the Windows-only helper routines declared in jit-w32.h, including formatting the current Win32 error and creating a private temporary directory with current-user ACLs. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the Windows API calls and security setup logic.
